photos.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: one landscape 3:2 photograph for a premium Estonian parquet and laminate flooring contractor website. Single genuine-looking architectural editorial photograph, not a collage, expensive attractive interior, exceptional flooring craftsmanship, restrained natural color, real wood/laminate texture and believable varied grain, absolutely no CGI gloss or plastic-looking wood, credible building geometry, no excessive wide angle. Floor is the primary subject and occupies at least 55 percent of the frame, impeccably installed, attractive natural lighting, subtle real-life imperfections. Absolutely no people, hands, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. No logos, text, watermark, display labels, paint tins, scattered tools, rugs obscuring the floor or generic furniture advertisement. Do not copy a narrow white room facing a small black garden door. Scene: spacious premium Nordic living room with long straight wide planks of natural honey-blond engineered oak, matte brushed grain and precise narrow butt joints. Low camera 65 cm above the floor near the corner gives a broad inviting foreground of uninterrupted oak leading diagonally toward soft daylight from tall side windows on the LEFT, understated limewashed warm greige walls, a single ivory linen lounge chair only at far right edge and a slim dark oak console at back. Finished matching slim oak skirting. Modern understated luxury, lived-real architectural photography, the texture and long plank layout dominate. No chevron, no herringbone pattern, no central garden door, no lake view.
